author: More Perfect Union
description:
Loan sharks found a loophole that lets them charge small businesses nearly 3,000% interest, and it's driving people into bankruptcy.

We talked to a dozen small business owners. Some report taking out $30,000 loans and having to pay back $160,000.

This is a quiet scam killing the middle class, but some states are seeking solutions.

There’s a bill moving through the California legislature right now that would require MCAs to have a license to operate in the state and disclose the true interest rates of their products.

If you want to show your support for this legislation, sign this letter to protect people from these loan sharks: https://www.borrowersbillofrights.org/protect-small-biz

Producer: @maeryan
Editor: Gina Barton
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The Hidden Loan Destroying Small Businesses With 2,900% Interest

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Big Tech claims AI data centers don’t use much water.

But data centers typically report the water used inside the facilities — we found them indirectly consuming 10x that amount.

We went to the drought-stricken West, where farmers now have to fight AI oligarchs for water.

Producer: Dan Lieberman
